description.en: Hold your Command Center against thirty generated rounds. Pick a Wave Defense AI in the lobby to choose where the waves come from.

Lets the Drop Pod spawn mode work. A drop pod lands a whole round on one spot away from the defenders, with a beacon warning first. Off by default because a bad landing is brutally unfair. With it off, a slot picked as Drop Pod plays as Base.
A dead boss leaves a crate holding one of its own components. Pick it up with any unit and that component becomes buildable. One crate per round.
Unlocks VTOL factories for the defenders. The waves never fly either way: flying designs are filtered out of the unit catalogue when it is generated.
